contract_event_requirements: at least one supplier identifier or exact supplier name present
cohort.deduplication: one deterministic eligible CONTRACT event per OCID; choose lexicographically smallest canonical event_id

outcome.conflict_policy: if explicit numberOfTenderers and non-empty tenderers-derived count disagree, quarantine
outcome.secondary_field: count distinct exact tenderer IDs, falling back to exact names, only when tender.tenderers is explicitly non-empty
outcome.zero_policy: an empty tenderers array is NOT bid_count=0

execution.selection: after full eligibility pass, sort each group by SHA-256(event_id) and select first min(target_per_group, eligible_group_count)
execution.terminal_if_sufficient: bounded canary may execute frozen Stage 09 statistics; Stage 10 remains blocked pending independent verification
